mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may increase CNS and cardiovascular side effects of varenicline; varenicline also has dose-dependent psychiatric and cardiovascular effects that could be potentiated by electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, especially potassium levels; counsel patient on varenicline's neuropsychiatric effects; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte depletion occurs.
